name: mla_vc_fp8_n_heads8_kv_lora_rank512_v_head_dim256
description: sglang's absorbed MLA value projection on one rank, kv_b_proj in fp8 at one scale per tensor, for a block-fp8 o_proj (rocm_absorb_v_bmm, then o_proj's input quantization): each head's attention output, quantized per 128-wide group to fp8 at max(amax, 1e-10) / 448, times w_vc and w_scale; the heads side by side, rounded to bf16, quantized per 128-wide group to fp8 at max(amax, 1e-10) / 448, its scales group by group.

n_tokens.description: Tokens in this call, padding rows included.

kv_lora_rank.description: The latent: the attention output's width per head.

out_dim.description: The heads' value channels side by side.

attn_output.description: Each head's attention output, in the latent's basis.

w_vc.description: kv_b_proj's value part per head, absorbed (sglang's w_vc, transposed): row v maps the latent to value channel v.

w_scale.description: kv_b_proj's per-tensor scale, one element: sglang's 0-d w_scale, viewed.

out_fp8.description: Each token's value channels in fp8 codes, per 128-wide group: o_proj's input.

out_scale.description: out_fp8's scale per group, group-major (row g holds group g of every token): transposed, the column-major scale aiter's preshuffled GEMM reads.
